note: Inyo NF campground at about 8,900 ft in Rock Creek Canyon, in four loops under pine, fir and aspen along Rock Creek; some sites sit along the creek. Bear lockers at every site and must be used. Next to the East Fork picnic and trailhead area. --Claude
summary: East Fork (Inyo NF, rec.gov 232396): rec.gov facility/rates/catalog/availability + FS page + imagery + 3DEP. $35 + $10 extra vehicle; season 05-15..10-03 (2026, weather-dependent), now closed for the season; 6-month window, 7 first-come sites; max 35 ft; flush toilets per FS. Creekside kept (east-edge 100-series sites on the floodplain within ~50 m, canopy-blind). Site count conflict (71 vs 133 vs stored 129). Pin ~420 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored creekside KEPT, canopy-blind. The north loop (sites 120-129) does not qualify: its loop road and a dense willow band separate it from the creek, ~45 m E. The candidates are the east-edge 100-series sites 111, 112, 114 and 116 (e.g. 111 at 37.48739,-118.71887; 112 at 37.48754,-118.71886) and 102/104. They sit east of their own loop road, inside the riparian forest. 3DEP puts site 111 on the same flat floodplain as the channel (2712.0 m vs 2711.5-2711.9 m across the ~50 m to the east slope), so the walk to the water is level. Rock Creek is well under 30 m here (~5-8 m where it shows in the meadow), so creekside is the right class. Imagery can't show the creek under the canopy, so this rests on the agency prose ('some sit along the banks of the creek'; FS 'some sites along the creek') plus the DEM. There is no per-site map or flag. If the reviewer wants a per-site artifact before keeping it, it is a downgrade lead to not waterfront.

SITES COUNT CONFLICT (count not written): the rec.gov catalog has 71 sites (46 RV, 25 tent-only); the FS page says '133 campsites'; stored 129 (note-derived). The catalog's numbering (001-056, 102-129) suggests it is the whole campground, and the FS figure may count Palisades Group / East Fork picnic. Reviewer: 71 (rec.gov) is the defensible value.
FACILITIES: stored vault_toilets true (note-derived, 2026-09-17) vs FS 'Flush toilet(s)' - wrote flush_toilets true; if facilities merges rather than replaces, clear vault_toilets (it has no source).
STATUS: FS 'Site Closed' (updated October 5, 2026) is the seasonal close after the 2026 season ended 10-03; no damage or closure order found. status not written.
